o: Complex sentence

q: Choose the correct compound form: They were too poor to buy the book.
o: They were very poor and they could not buy the book.
They were very poor but bought the book.
They are very poor and they can buy the book.
They were too poor and they could buy the book.

q: Which of the following is the correct complex sentence for the compound sentence: "I have a sister, and she is a doctor."
o: I have a sister who is a doctor.
I have a sister, who she is a doctor.
I had a sister who she is a doctor.
I have a sister, and who is a doctor.

q: Besides eating rice, he took coffee. (Make it compound)
o: He not only ate rice but also took coffee.
He ate rice and also took coffee.
Not only he eat rice but also took coffee.
He ate both rice and coffee.

q: Transform the assertive sentence "The scenery is very beautiful." into an exclamatory sentence.
o: How beautiful the scenery is!
What a beautiful scenery!
Wow, the scenery is so beautiful!
How wonderful the scenery is!

q: Though he is wealthy, he is unhappy.(make it simple)
o: He is wealthy but unhappy.
Despite of his wealth, he is unhappy.
In spite of his wealth, he is unhappy.
He is wealthy and unhappy.

q: Riya is one of the tallest girls in the class. (Make it comparative)
o: Riya is tall than most other girls in the class.
Riya is more taller than most other girls in the class.
Riya is taller than most other girls in the class.
Riya is taller than any other girls in the class.
